Ethan Support: FYI - customer 'ClearBridge' (BR-221) onboarding blocked: activation emails failing after SSO setup. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/68211
Priya CS: urgent - renewal in how many days? who is CSM? @Jordan
Ethan Support: renewal ~48 days. Jordan is CSM. They're running an eval with two pilot teams.
Jordan CS Manager: on call. paste the error and what IdP sent over pls.
Ethan Support: log excerpt:
```
ERROR: AssertionConsumerService URL mismatch (expected https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs)
Received ACS: https://sso.clearbridge.com/acs
```
Ethan Support: support tried reprovisioning; IdP says they updated metadata but still failing.
Priya CS: immediate plan: 1) warm transfer to CS in 15m, 2) customer-safe status update now, 3) prepare a technical fallback for Solutions. Jordan can you own transfer and set success metric?
Jordan CS Manager: taking handoff. Success metric = all seats activated for pilot teams by EOD tomorrow. I'll schedule a quick enablement and loop in AE if needed.
Sam Solutions: drafting fallback steps: short and reversible.
- confirm SP ACS in account settings
- temporary alternative: create a test ACS URL and redirect
- command: `redwood auth rebind --tenant BR-221 --acs https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs --dry-run`
Maya Eng: I can validate metadata mapping in staging and run a quick cert refresh if needed.
Priya CS: comms: I'll send two templates (ops-facing + exec-friendly). Ethan please send the exec-friendly note now: "We've identified an SSO provisioning mismatch; working on a temporary workaround and will schedule a call for tomorrow morning PST." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ethan Support: sent at 4105556701. Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll join a morning slot. Please include our IdP admin." :white_check_mark:
Jordan CS Manager: next steps recap: Jordan -> warm transfer & invite; Sam -> publish fallback in #eng-platform; Maya -> run staging validation; Priya -> log renewal watch & 7-day cadence; OpsBot -> create task.
OpsBot: Created task BR-221-onboard-warm-transfer assigned Jordan, due 4105557380.
Priya CS: noted product feedback: onboarding docs should include ACS mismatch troubleshooting and IdP example snippets. I'll file to product board. Follow-up summary incoming after the enablement call. Thanks team. :pray:
